text:
dalia: FYI support escalated — customer (acme-health) says their SIEM shows a gap: export job ej-2027-04-12-87 returned 0 events for 02:00-03:00 UTC. They need forensic logs for compliance. Can eng-security take a look?

sam: thx. can you paste the job id + org + S3 key prefix if available? any error snippets from customer?

dalia: job id ej-2027-04-12-87, org=acme-health, s3://redwood-exports/prod/acme-health/ej-2027-04-12-87/ (they attached empty _SUCCESS and zero-byte parts). customer says other hours are fine.

lauren: pulling export job in infra. I see the job completed, total_objects: 5, total_bytes: 0. shards: 6, shard-3 wrote 0 bytes and uploaded empty part. Looking at transform logs:

```
2027-04-12T02:14:59Z ERROR export/transform.go:142 retention_filter: no matching events for org=acme-health window=2027-04-12T02:00->03:00 export_job=ej-2027-04-12-87 shard=3
2027-04-12T02:15:00Z INFO export/uploader.go:78 upload part=ej-2027-04-12-87/shard-3/part-1 size=0
```

lauren: that "no matching events" looks suspicious — either retention filter removed them or the schema mismatch made the transform skip events. we changed a retention predicate last week.

miguel: we rotated KMS key at 01:58 UTC for backups. wondering if decrypt failed for that timeframe -> caused parser to drop events? checking kms logs.

audit-bot: export_job.created ej-2027-04-12-87 org=acme-health initiated_by=support_bot

miguel: KMS logs show DECRYPT OK for all parts at 02:10 and 02:12, no errors. HSM op latency normal. so not KMS.

lauren: ok, I grep the raw event stream for that org/time window from the write-ahead logs: there are events, but they contain field "type" instead of "event_type" which our transform expects. transform code does an explicit schema match and drops records that don't have event_type.

sam: ah — was there a schema migration recently? I remember a lightweight change in the ingestion schema for telemetry last week.

lauren: yes — feature flag ff/retention-strict went live at 02:05 UTC (deploy ID: deploy-2027-04-12-19). That rollout included a stricter transform that enforces event_type presence. It should have been behind a compat check.

oncall-ops: pinging eng-runtime — can we roll the flag back quickly and re-run export? customer needs logs for compliance audit.

lauren: created incident ticket SEC-4872 with notes and rollback playbook. Recommended immediate steps:
1) Roll ff/retention-strict -> off for org acme-health
2) Kick a manual ad-hoc export with --from=2027-04-12T02:00Z --to=2027-04-12T03:00Z --org=acme-health --dry-run to verify counts
3) If dry-run shows hits, run full export and notify customer

sam: repro steps I used locally:
```
$ ./tools/export --org acme-health --from 2027-04-12T02:00Z --to 2027-04-12T03:00Z --dry-run
Transform: matched=0 dropped=423 schema_mismatch=423
```

sam: the transform logged 423 dropped records due to missing event_type.

lauren: mitigation plan: quick fix is to accept the alternate field name in transform (event_type || type) and backfill export. longer term, add a compatibility layer and improve CI to run a production-like export during schema flag flips.

miguel: I can run a targeted backfill decrypt + transform on the raw WAL for that window and produce a one-off export. It will need elevated S3 write perms; I'll coordinate with infra.

dalia: customer replied they need a signed integrity manifest + S3 URLs. we should also note this for SOC compliance.

lauren: logging the action items in SEC-4872: lauren assign, miguel doing backfill (ETA 3h), sam to communicate to customer, oncall-ops to disable flag for acme-health.

oncall-ops: flag disabled for acme-health at 02:45 UTC (ff/retention-strict=false for org=acme-health). verified no other orgs affected.

miguel: backfill started at 03:05 UTC; dry-run shows matched=423, full export in progress. will upload signed manifest when done.

sam: thanks team. customer acknowledges, asked for postmortem and what we changed to prevent recurrence.

lauren: postmortem will include root cause (schema-compat bug in retention transform + premature flag promotion), timeline, customer impact, and remediation: feature-flag gating, compatibility tests, and export smoke test. I'll draft and tag compliance.

audit-bot: incident SEC-4872 updated: state=investigating assignee=lauren

oncall-ops: closing loop — export completed and uploaded at s3://redwood-exports/prod/acme-health/ej-2027-04-12-87-fixed/ parts=6 size=2.3MB manifest=ej-2027-04-12-87-manifest.json sha256=... :white_check_mark:

dalia: customer confirmed receipt and compliance signed off. they asked for exported schema mapping file — sam will attach. :relieved:

sam: attaching schema_map_v1_to_v2.json and brief note on how we interpreted legacy "type" -> new "event_type" mapping.

lauren: closing actions: add compatibility check to export pipeline, add integration test to deploy gating, and document KMS/HSM checks for export runbooks.

oncall-ops: marking thread resolved. :thumbsup:
